name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Two additions. (1) Federated movies/episodes can now be exported as .strm files (Advanced settings → "Export federated content as .strm files for Plex") - plain text files containing just the item's existing proxy stream URL, written under a configurable path on every refresh. Plex has no plugin system for browsing a remote catalog the way this plugin does for Jellyfin, so this is how federated content becomes visible to it: point a Plex library at the exported Movies/Shows folders and it scans and streams them like any other file, through the same relay every other federated play already uses - nothing is downloaded or duplicated. (2) A new "Download to device" action-sheet entry alongside the existing "Download" (to server): resolves the same proxy stream URL with a Content-Disposition header so the browser saves a copy straight to the viewer's own device, without this server ever writing it to disk. 256 tests, all green.
